messages:
alex: quick security ask — trying to repro a staging race condition. Can we get a one-off request+response dump for /v1/generate for 1 hour? Will redact tokens and pseudonymize emails. Config proposal below.

alex: config I'd apply at the edge proxy:```
capture_window: 1h
endpoints: ["/v1/generate"]
redact_headers: ["Authorization", "Cookie"]
redact_body_rules:
  - path: "$.prompt"
    action: hmac_sha256
    key_ref: "kms://projects/redwood/keys/debug-hmac"
  - path: "$.user.email"
    action: mask_emails
storage:
  s3_path: "s3://redwood-temp-debug/staging/2250123456"
  retention_hours: 24
access: ["alex", "devops-team"]
```

alex: will remove all Authorization headers at proxy level so raw tokens never hit S3. HMAC key is in KMS, no plaintext salt in config.

priya: short Qs — who approves access to that S3 path, and do we log request metadata (user ids) anywhere else? need to ensure minimality.

alex: access only to listed principals (alex + devops-team). We'll add an IAM condition and temporary grant via ticket. No other logs should contain full body; meta logs stay (status, latency, traceid).

morgan_sec: a couple reqs from security side: 1) we need an audit entry created before enabling, include ticket # and reason 2) HMAC key rotation note in the ticket 3) explicit deny on copying to external buckets.

alex: got it — will create ticket and include HMAC rotation plan + expiration. Ticket will be #INC-3121 and link in here before we enable.

priya: also add a quick smoke test plan: sample request id list to validate redaction (we'll check that Authorization isnt present and prompt field shows 64-char hex hmac).

alex: will post sample IDs once capture is live. plan to run tracer and then delete S3 when validated.

jordan: if you want a faster approval flow I can scope it to a single proxy node and timebox the ip/port. thumbs up if you prefer that.

alex: thanks — prefer whole proxy pool (race appears two nodes) but will keep to 1h.

morgan_sec: approved with conditions: 1) ticket # in place 2) retention 24h enforced 3) IAM temporary grant only 4) security will run the redaction verification steps before deletion. Post the ticket and I will flip the toggle. :white_check_mark:

sec-bot: Security approval recorded by morgan_sec — conditions applied (ticket=INC-3121, retention=24h, key_ref=kms://projects/redwood/keys/debug-hmac). Automated revoke scheduled at +25h.

alex: thanks all — creating ticket now and will ping when ready to flip the switch.
